changePolicy: This gate may only be changed by re-versioning (release-gate-g6-calibration-v2, ...) BEFORE the final holdout evaluation begins. Any edit after the final holdout evaluation has started, or any in-place softening at any time, voids the certification. A pinned sha256 test (packages/swing-lab/test/h18FrozenReleaseGate.test.ts) enforces immutability.
scope: GO / NO-GO criteria for the calibration & silent-failure dimension (Gate 6) of the final Pickle Sensei production certification. Other gates (latency, session stability, consent, coach content, capture envelope) are certified separately; this gate alone cannot produce an overall GO.

definitions.contract: silent-failure-v1.1 (packages/swing-lab/src/silentFailure.ts) — a silent failure is a user-visible confident material claim (TARGET_IDENTITY, EVENT, STROKE_L1, CONTACT_MARKER, PHASE_RENDER) that gold says is wrong; abstentions are never silent failures; disputed gold is excluded-and-disclosed
definitions.trial: one gold-labeled stroke case run end-to-end through the canonical cascade (pnpm lab:cascade on the canonical Mac environment); frames are NEVER trials
definitions.answeredTrial: a trial where >= 1 of the five claims is answered and gold-verifiable
definitions.grouping: every reported rate must list per-session/source counts (session = independent footage source); pooled rates without per-session counts do not satisfy this gate

denominatorRules: Trials are gold-labeled cases grouped by independent source session — never frames, never machine-labeled (Tier-C) cases.
The held-out cases (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) are evaluated EXACTLY ONCE, after this freeze, in the final holdout evaluation; no tuning, re-runs, or label edits after first contact.
The final holdout evaluation set must contain >= 2 independent source sessions; a single-session holdout cannot certify this gate.
Abstentions stay in every coverage denominator.
No threshold, assertion, or denominator in this document may be adjusted to fit the holdout outcome.

G6-1_silentFailureAnswered.requirement: 0 silent failures among answered trials on the final holdout evaluation (silent-failure-v1.1, all five claims)
G6-1_silentFailureAnswered.rationale: confident wrongness is the P0 class this product was rebuilt around (wrong target, wrong event, confident wrong stroke, fabricated contact, impossible phase render); the measured RC posture already achieves 0 answered silent failures on the latest committed canonical run (0/3 answered dev trials), so the release bar is not aspirational
G6-1_silentFailureAnswered.noGoTrigger: any single answered silent failure of any claim is NO-GO for this gate

G6-2_fabricatedContact.requirement: 0 contact markers with |err| > 132ms vs gold, and 0 markers in 66-132ms shown without ball/paddle confirmation, across ALL holdout trials
G6-2_fabricatedContact.rationale: a fabricated marker is worse than none (usable-result-v1 clause 5); this is restated separately from G6-1 because it is also enforced at the UI routing layer (contactMarkerPresentation) and both layers must hold

G6-3_coverageFloor.requirement: coverage (answered trials / all trials) >= 0.5 on holdout trials whose capture passes the supported-capture envelope, with >= 2 source sessions represented among answered trials
G6-3_coverageFloor.rationale: a system that abstains on most supported captures is not releasable even at zero silent failure (excess abstention is the P1 axis); 0.5 matches the measured dev posture (2/3 dev trials fully answered, 1/3 honest abstention) and the g20 finding that every stage's max-coverage endpoint is Pareto-efficient
G6-3_coverageFloor.noGoTrigger: coverage < 0.5 on supported-capture holdout trials is NO-GO for this gate (P1 class: must fix before broad release)

G6-4_usableResultFloor.requirement: usable-result-v1 rate >= 0.5 on supported-capture holdout trials
G6-4_usableResultFloor.rationale: the usable second-north-star is the user-facing bar: strict survival may lag, but at least half of supported holdout captures must yield a trustworthy-evidence Result; latest measured dev posture is 2/3 usable
G6-4_usableResultFloor.noGoTrigger: usable rate < 0.5 is NO-GO for this gate

G6-5_confidenceRouting.requirement: on holdout replays, the confidence routing must behave as designed with zero violations: (a) contact — abstention or unconfirmed confidence < 0.6 draws NO marker; confirmed or confidence >= 0.6 draws a marker with uncertainty halo monotonically widening as confidence falls, bounded to [33ms, 165ms] half-width; (b) stroke — UNKNOWN/null routes to explicit 'not identified', never an invented label; (c) no raw confidence decimals surface to the user
G6-5_confidenceRouting.rationale: routing is the mechanism that converts calibration into user safety; verified on RC replays by datasets/experiments/wave-h/h18-calibration-cert.ts with 0 violations on 15 committed contact-gold replay units and 18 stroke bench units

G6-6_calibrationRegression.requirement: no stage's selective-risk posture may regress vs the frozen RC baseline (datasets/experiments/wave-g/g20-selective-risk-curves.json refreshed at datasets/experiments/wave-h/h18-cert-report.json riskCoverageViews): at the production operating point (t=0), silent-failure risk among answered must not exceed the RC baseline by more than one wrong answer per stage on comparable committed-data replays
G6-6_calibrationRegression.rationale: prevents silent decay of the answer/abstain balance between certification and release

verdictRule: GO on Gate 6 requires ALL of G6-1 through G6-6 to hold on the final holdout evaluation. Any noGoTrigger fires NO-GO. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL (e.g. Mac unavailable for the canonical cascade) means the gate is NOT certified — it is never converted to GO by substituting non-canonical evidence.
measurementBoundaryAtFreeze: All RC numbers cited here were measured on Linux from committed artifacts (latest canonical Mac cascade runs of 2026-08-28/29, committed replay harnesses); no new Mac/iPhone measurements existed at freeze time. The final holdout evaluation requires the canonical Mac environment.
